name: VC Lead Finder
description: Find and rank relevant VC funds for benchmarking or outreach. Outputs a CSV-ready lead table with contact routes.

inputs.label: Project context
inputs.placeholder: What is the outreach for? Include client, project, reason for contacting VCs, and desired angle.

inputs.label: Target VC profile
inputs.placeholder: e.g. European early-stage VC funds, student-run VCs, seed funds with portfolio analytics or fund benchmarking experience.

inputs.label: Geography
inputs.placeholder: e.g. Europe, Netherlands, UK, DACH, Nordics

inputs.label: Must include / filters
inputs.placeholder:
student-run VC
portfolio benchmarking
early-stage fund
public contact email
